Bournemouth Capitalize on Goalkeeper Error to Extend Winning Streak Against Leeds

01 Nov 2026, 10:41 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

Image: https://www.theguardian.com/profile/john-brewin · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9 for the website

Key takeaways Match Summary Bournemouth extended their winning run to six successive matches with a victory over Leeds, capitalising on a first-half defensive error by goalkeeper James Trafford. The result leaves Bournemouth continuing a strong run of form under their current setup

Match Summary

Bournemouth extended their winning run to six successive matches with a victory over Leeds, capitalising on a first-half defensive error by goalkeeper James Trafford. The result leaves Bournemouth continuing a strong run of form under their current setup, while Leeds suffered a setback despite an encouraging opening half-hour.

Key Turning Point

  • The Opening Goal: Leeds had controlled much of the early play before Trafford mishandled a pass intended for teammate Ao Tanaka.
  • The Finish: Justin Kluivert intercepted the loose ball and set up Evanilson to score, marking the forward's fifth goal in six matches.
  • The Consequence: The error altered the momentum of the match, sapping Leeds's confidence and allowing Bournemouth to take control.

Manager Reactions

Following the match, Leeds manager Daniel Farke defended his goalkeeper, noting that Trafford has otherwise been a strong signing and expressing confidence that the young player will recover. Farke also lamented a disallowed goal earlier in the match, where a potential opener by Dominic Calvert-Lewin was overturned following a VAR review due to an accidental handball.

Bournemouth's staff praised Evanilson's intelligent movement and work rate before substituting him ahead of an upcoming Europa League fixture in Prague.

Match Facts and Milestones

  • Bournemouth secured their third consecutive Premier League clean-sheet victory.
  • The home side sealed the win in stoppage time when Eli Junior Kroupi supplied Amine Adli for the team's second goal.
  • Evanilson became the first Brazilian to score a Premier League goal on Halloween since Raphinha in 2021.
